bio: Bailara’s contemporary ambience in a rural hotel in the heart of nature definitely strikes a chord! The modern-inspired cuisine on offer here is centred around a single surprise tasting menu that showcases seasonal dishes and is based around ingredients sourced from local producers (asparagus, teardrop peas, artichokes, cep mushrooms etc) and meat from local breeders. We particularly enjoyed the charcoal-grilled beef tacos!...
